description: Detection/non-detection of 74 fish species in 100 HUC12 watersheds of the Upper and Middle New River basin (Virginia/North Carolina) across 26 three-year primary periods (1938-2014), compiled from collection records; years within a period are secondary occasions and the number of collections per HUC-year is the effort covariate.
reference: Frimpong, E. (2017). Fish Detection Histories and Covariates, Upper and Middle New River Drainage Basin (Virginia and North Carolina, USA). Harvard Dataverse, V1.
notes: No associated paper identified on Crossref. Surveyed = at least one collection record that HUC-year.

description: Camera-trap detection/non-detection of guigna, Molina's hog-nosed skunk, foxes (Lycalopex), domestic dog and domestic cat at 180 grid-cell camera stations over up to 14 five-night occasions in agricultural landscapes of La Araucania, Chile (2019), with camera nights and human detections per occasion and 13 landscape metrics per station.
reference: Galvez, N., Infante, J., Fernandez, A., Diaz, J., & Petracca, L. (2021). Land use intensification coupled with free-roaming dogs as potential defaunation drivers of mesocarnivores in agricultural landscapes. Journal of Applied Ecology, 58(12), 2962-2974.
notes: Licence conflict: Dryad metadata CC0, deposited readme ODbL/DbCL; the stricter (ODbL) governs and propagates (intake policy). 693 of 2,520 unit-occasions not surveyed (trailing). Fetched as the Dryad version zip.

description: Calling index (0 none to 3 full chorus) of 14 frog and toad species inside the study plot on 2,216 night-time site visits at 70 Atchafalaya Basin sites, Louisiana (2008-2016), with the outside-plot index as a covariate, survey conditions, observers and site coordinates.
reference: Glorioso, B.M., and Waddle, J.H., 2025, Data from time-constrained visual encounter surveys and acoustic surveys for amphibians and reptiles in the Atchafalaya Basin conducted from 2008 through 2016: U.S. Geological Survey data release.
notes: Ordinal calling index (responseType ordinal, standard E2). Orphan Sample ID 348 and five 'done in error' samples dropped. Companion: glorioso_2025_atchafalaya_ves.

description: Counts of 47 amphibian and reptile species on 2,216 night-time time-constrained visual encounter surveys at 70 sites in the Atchafalaya Basin, Louisiana (2008-2016; 4-6 samples per site-year), with survey duration, weather and water variables, observers, and site coordinates.
reference: Glorioso, B.M., and Waddle, J.H., 2025, Data from time-constrained visual encounter surveys and acoustic surveys for amphibians and reptiles in the Atchafalaya Basin conducted from 2008 through 2016: U.S. Geological Survey data release.
notes: Zeros built from the sample table (a sample exists iff a row in Sample_Data). Orphan Sample ID 348 and five 'done in error' samples dropped. Companion table: glorioso_2025_atchafalaya_calls.

description: Detection/non-detection of nine amphibian species (eggs, larvae or adults) at 100 ponds in Hungary over three combined visual/dip-net/trap surveys in 2023, with eight per-survey covariates (date, VES effort, water temperature and level, wind, rain, fish, emergent vegetation).
reference: Hamer, A. J., & Horanyi, J. (2024). Improving inference within freshwater community studies: Accounting for variable detection rates of amphibians and fish. Ecology and Evolution, 14(10), e70383.
notes: Fetched as the Dryad version zip (per-file API downloads need a bearer token). One pond-survey (T9, survey 1) not conducted.

description: Camera-trap detection/non-detection of chilla fox, culpeo fox, guigna and domestic dog at 48 camera stations over up to 12 seven-day occasions in a fragmented agricultural landscape of Los Lagos, Chile (2019), with six camera-level habitat covariates.
reference: Malhotra, R., Jimenez, J., & Harris, N. (2021). Patch characteristics and domestic dogs differentially affect carnivore space use in fragmented landscapes in southern Chile. Diversity and Distributions, 27(12).
notes: Files fetched from the Zenodo mirror (record 5106824) because anonymous Dryad downloads return 401. Dog_occu (model output) not shipped.

description: Counts of 112 bird species on breeding-season point counts at 260 points along forest rights-of-way and controls in the central Appalachians (2016-2019), two visits per point per treatment-relative year (pre, +1, +2), with date, observer, time and treatment code; built from per-individual detection records, flyovers excluded.
reference: Margenau, E. L., Wood, P. B., & Rota, C. T. (2022). Habitat management for stopover and breeding songbird communities along rights-of-way in forest-dominated landscapes. Ecological Applications, 32(3), e2540.
notes: Zeros inferred: a point-year-visit is a survey iff it has at least one detection row (four explicit Count = 0 rows show empty counts were logged). Flyovers (75 rows) excluded; UNCH/UNWO/BARO dropped; CAGO merged into CANG. Stopover file not converted. Fetched as the Dryad version zip.

description: Weekly camera-trap detection/non-detection (with the number of detection episodes in y_raw) of 18 mammal species at 355 game cameras across an urban-to-rural gradient in Northwest Arkansas over two winter seasons (16 and 22 weeks), with camera-days per week as effort and study site as cluster.
reference: McTigue, L. E., & DeGregorio, B. A. (2024). Nine-banded Armadillo (Dasypus novemcinctus) occupancy and density across an urban-to-rural gradient. Southeastern Naturalist, 23(4), 529-548.
notes: Built from a per-detection record table: surveyed camera-weeks inferred from first/last detection per camera-year (deployment dates in the file are inconsistent). Density/covariate file unjoinable (site labels differ). Fetched as the Dryad version zip.

description: Presence/absence of 43 bird species at 10 point-count stations in east-central Argentina over 4 seasons x 5 visits (200 surveys per point), with 19 species-level functional traits (body mass, diet, foraging stratum, foraging behaviour) in the taxa side table.
reference: Palacio, F. X., Maragliano, R. E., & Montalti, D. (2020). The costs of ignoring species detectability on functional diversity estimation. The Auk, 137(4), ukaa057.
notes: Files fetched from the Zenodo mirror (record 4728255). 10 sites: below the proposed 30-unit floor, but 43 species x 20 surveys per site.

description: Daily camera-trap detection/non-detection of Baird's tapir at 22 cameras (6-72 camera-days each) in Rio Indio, Nicaragua, June-August 2014, with camera-days of effort and coarsened (0.1 degree) camera coordinates.
reference: Schank, C. (2015). Tapir detection histories (Tapirus bairdii) from Rio Indio, Nicaragua [Data set]. Zenodo.
notes: No associated paper identified. Coordinates coarsened to a 0.1-degree grid (Endangered taxon). 22 units: below the proposed 30-unit floor.

description: Cormack-Jolly-Seber capture histories of 175 banded adult Plain-crested Elaenia (Elaenia cristata) across nine capture sessions in northeastern Brazil, 2010-2014, from a Program MARK input file; four losses on capture flagged in obs_removed.
reference: Toledo-Lima, G. S., et al. (2026). The effects of rainfall patterns and the influx of a migratory congener on the survival of Plain-crested Elaenia. Studies on Neotropical Fauna and Environment.
notes: Paper matched on Crossref by author and species, not named in the deposit; verify. MARK freq = -1 (loss on capture) encoded per standard section 2.1.

description: Yearly territory status (absent / territorial pair / pair with chicks) of Pacific and Yellow-billed Loons at 117 lake territories in the National Petroleum Reserve-Alaska, 2011-2014, with lake coordinates and presence of five fish species as site covariates.
reference: Uher-Koch, B.D., Wright, K.G., & Uher-Koch, H.R. (2020). Effects of fish populations on Pacific Loon (Gavia pacifica) and Yellow-billed Loon (G. adamsii) lake occupancy and chick production in northern Alaska. Arctic, 73(4).
notes: USGS data release (public domain, CC0 stated in metadata). Multi-state response: y is the per-species state 0/1/2, y_raw the source code 0-4. Paper matched on Crossref; verify.
